scientific_integrity: The full size-spectrum and matching primal-dual argument are proved for all n>=5; finite BFS enumeration is supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Two-element Kneser graphs with n>=5; fractional edge resolving only. The Petersen scalar case and general symmetry reduction are previously known; unrestricted priority and independent scientific validation remain open.
title: Fractional edge dimension and full resolving-neighborhood spectrum of two-subset Kneser graphs
